author: /root/hepta_audit
purpose: Decode the immutable compressed evidence payload only. This is not product code, a product test, the original checker or a native qualification.

usage.source_is: Exactly inflateRawDeflate.toString(), a self-contained named function expression/declaration.
usage.returns: Uint8Array of exactly expectedUncompressedLength or throws.
usage.dependencies: Standard ECMAScript built-ins only; no Node, import, filesystem, network, native codec or platform decompressor.

contract.format: One raw DEFLATE stream, as produced by Python zlib.compressobj(level=9, wbits=-15). No zlib/gzip wrapper or preset dictionary.
valid_cases: Canonical Huffman codes decode in transmitted most-significant code-bit order while raw fields/byte packing use least-significant-bit order.
Dynamic code-length repeats 16/17/18, including zero-length runs and bounded alphabet repetition.
An unused empty distance alphabet is accepted; using a distance from it is rejected.
Overlapping LZ77 references copy forward and preserve history across block boundaries.
Distances up to 32768 and lengths up to 258.
Unused padding bits in the last byte are ignored; any complete trailing byte after the final block is rejected.
throws_on: Invalid byte input or expected length.
Any input truncation encountered by bit/byte decoding.
Reserved block type, reserved literal/length symbols or reserved distance symbols.
Oversubscribed Huffman trees, disallowed incomplete trees, empty code-length/literal trees, invalid Huffman codes and missing end-of-block.
Repeat16 without a predecessor, or any code-length repeat past the declared combined literal/distance alphabet.
Back-reference distance before the beginning of output history.
Output beyond expected length or a final output shorter than expected.
Trailing complete bytes after the final block.
contract.allocation_bound: Output allocation and writes are bounded by the caller's validated expectedLength; allocation failure also throws.
contract.integrity_rule: Successful inflation alone is not acceptance. Require exact uncompressed length, full Git blob ID and SHA-256 against independently retained original evidence before parsing or replaying the patch.
